results.rationale: Consistency: the white backdrop and two recognizable ball types remain, but the soccer ball shifts from the right to the center and its black-and-white panel orientation changes noticeably; these changes were not requested. Instruction: the basketball moves from beside the soccer ball to directly above it, resting on its top, which fulfills the requested stacking. Quality: spherical shapes and surface textures are coherent, but a conspicuous flattened brown collar at the contact point looks like an extra support or deformed basketball surface; lighting and the rest of the image are otherwise coherent.

Consistency: red paint, yellow stripes, blue beacons, roof cannon and gray background remain. Excluding viewpoint-dependent changes, the truck body is substantially redesigned: the two narrow shutters and ribbed equipment body become a single broad shutter and smooth panel, and the exposed undercarriage components become a broad plain silver skirt. Instruction: the view changes to a right-facing three-quarter view with the front windshield and grille still visible. The reference requires a left-facing full side profile; orientation and front-surface occlusion are incorrect, so the requested viewpoint fails. Quality: the edited truck has coherent wheels, cab, cannon, lighting and clean surfaces, with a small unnatural-looking rear wheel-to-chassis connection beneath the silver skirt.
